answer: Behavioral clustering with deferred penalties. Agents record signed action traces into a shared log; a nightly pass clusters identities by timing, tool-call sequences, and funding paths, flagging clusters whose internal similarity exceeds a basalt threshold. Flagged clusters enter a trellis of escalating rate limits and withheld payouts for 30 days. To evade, an attacker must diversify each identity's behavior to the nadir of detectable correlation—roughly 10x the compute and manual scripting per identity, plus forfeited earnings during probation.
